# CANDIDATE: VWAP_CONT_TIGHT_TIME_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the VWAP_CONTINUATION entry window to the first 30 minutes of trading (09:30-10:00 ET) will increase edge_capture by focusing on the most reliable morning continuation moves and avoiding midday chop, while preserving the core edge observed in live trading.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger: VWAP_CONTINUATION signal (first ≤10:30-ET bar that continues in-trend) but only if the bar timestamp is between 09:30:00 and 10:00:00 ET. Exit logic remains unchanged: chart-stop-primary (session extreme against trade), TP1 at +50% premium (sell 2/3), runner with chandelier profit-lock (arms at +5%, trails 15%), time stop 15:50 ET.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (based on 50% risk cap and $1.00 avg entry premium).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest uses 16 months of cached SPY 5m bars (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with OPRA real-fills simulation for top 3 J days. Selection method: automatic grinder sweep over parameter space (time window start/end). Overfit risk: mitigated by walk-forward OOS and concentration checks.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet run; will be conducted in Stage-2).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA fill simulation on top 3 J days not yet performed; requires Stage-1 backtest completion).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: whipsaw in tight window causing multiple stops (e.g., range-bound morning).
   - Max drawdown: potential -$500 per trade if stopped immediately after entry.
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent morning failure mode (e.g., 5 consecutive days of reversed triggers) leading to sequential losses exceeding daily loss cap.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (will compute top-5 days % of P&L after backtest).

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
- Gym validators: all core tests must pass (e.g., test_vwap_continuation_watcher.py).
- Walk-forward: OOS Sharpe ratio ≥ 0.70 and positive OOS P&L.
- Real-fills: simulation on top 3 J days must show < ±20% deviation from BS-sim for anchor days.
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture on J winners must not decrease (must retain at least 2/3 winners).
- Concentration: top-5 days ≤ 50% of total P&L.
